description: This file defines the JavaMailContainer class, which manages email retrieval via JavaMail API in an OFBiz environment. It handles initialization, configuration, session and store management, periodic polling of the inbox, message processing, and optional message deletion.

classes.name: JavaMailContainer
classes.description: Main class managing email fetching, session/store handling, and polling in the OFBiz environment.

classes.name: LoggingStoreListener
classes.description: Inner class implementing StoreListener to log store events.

classes.name: PollerTask
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to periodically check email inbox and process messages.

classes.name: MimeMessageWrapper
classes.description: Referenced class in processMessage, assumed to be a utility wrapper around MimeMessage (not provided in the snippet).

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with commands, name, and config file.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Loads configuration, establishes delegator and dispatcher, initializes stores, and starts polling timer.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a JavaMail Session with provided properties.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Obtains and tests a mail Store from the session.

methods.name: updateUrlName
methods.description: Constructs an updated URLName with proper credentials, host, port.

methods.name: checkMessages
methods.description: Connects to mail store, fetches unread messages, and processes them.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Handles individual messages, wrapping them and invoking rule evaluation.
